title: orchis lactea subsp. broteroana
intro: Orchis lactea subsp. broteroana, commonly known as the Portuguese orchid, is a subspecies of orchid that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, where it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Orchis lactea subsp. broteroana include relieving coughs, reducing inflammation, and promoting digestion. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
